---
title: Working with Vector Spatial Data
categories: [spatial-data, data-visualization, tidyverse, lecture, advanced]
description: "Vector spatial data using sf, spatial joins, and creating static and interactive maps with ggplot2 and leaflet."
---

:::{.callout-learning}
After completing this session, you will be able to:

- Read, inspect, and write vector spatial data using `sf`
- Understand and transform coordinate reference systems (CRS)
- Join spatial and non-spatial data
- Summarize geometries with `dplyr`
- Make static maps with `ggplot2` and interactive maps with `leaflet`
:::
